svg.text: loracamera — base station wiring (local node, Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4-R8)
microSD card for every received picture, LiPo + solar power. Schematic, not to scale. Remote node: see wiring.svg.
charges the LiPo through the board
Requests pictures from the remote node over LoRa.
Saves each received file to the SD card
Uploads it to server/listen.py when Wi-Fi
is connected; without Wi-Fi it keeps
Header J2 is unused; no 5 V needed.
• Pin numbers follow the V4-R8 datasheet (J3 pin 1 = GND); highlighted pins are used. GPIO38/39/41 are also on the GNSS connector: leave it empty.
